title: ERSTE002
ERSTE002
body: 为右手设计的超轻量游戏鼠标。按键、上盖与开放式底部构成一条连续的轮廓。
An ultralight gaming mouse designed for the right hand. Its buttons, shell and open underside form a continuous profile.

title: 食指高，中指低
Index higher, middle lower
body: 按右手握持方向看，左键承接食指，右键承接中指。正面标记取自两片键盖在同一前后位置的表面。
In the right-hand grip, the left button supports the index finger and the right supports the middle finger. The front-view markers sample both covers at the same depth.

title: 倾斜延伸到上盖
The slope continues
body: 从斜上方看，较高的食指侧和较低的中指侧顺着按键盖延伸到上盖，两侧曲面各自收向侧壁。
From above, the higher index side and lower middle side continue into the upper shell before turning into their respective sidewalls.

title: 顺着右手的自然倾斜
Following the right-hand tilt
body: 镜头从前端绕向后部，左高右低延续至掌心支撑。整机的非对称曲面，意在顺应右手与手腕握持时的自然倾斜。
The view moves from nose to tail, following the slope into the palm support. The asymmetric body is designed to accommodate the natural tilt of the right hand and wrist.

title: 从整机看装配
From product to parts
body: 开放式底部省去传统底壳。上盖、按键盖、滚轮、主板和电池是这次装配检视的五组部件。
The open underside dispenses with a conventional base shell. Five groups make up the assembly view: shell, buttons, wheel, reference board and battery.

title: 完整爆炸
Full exploded view
body: 五组部件沿装配轴分离。主板和电池为装配示意，便于看清它们与上盖的相对位置。
The five groups separate along the assembly axis. The board and battery are references that show their positions relative to the shell.

title: 侧切上盖
Cutting into the shell
body: 切面从侧壁向内推进。实体封口随切面移动，保留模型的真实壁厚与内部空腔。
The section moves inward from the sidewall. Its solid cut face preserves the model’s actual wall thickness and cavities.

title: 类工字形截面
I-like rib section
body: 镜头靠近侧切面。上盖截边、肋腹和下缘在这里形成类工字形轮廓。
In close-up, the shell edge, rib web and lower flange form an I-like profile.

title: 加强筋如何接进薄壳
How the ribs meet the shell
body: 从下方看，弧形加强筋贴着上盖并接入侧壁。横向撑杆连接两侧，让支撑关系跨过开放底部。
From below, curved ribs follow the upper shell and tie into the sidewall. Transverse braces connect the two sides across the open underside.

title: 按键盖内侧加强筋
Ribs under the button covers
body: 按键盖移到画面中央并翻转，独立展示两片键盖内侧的加强筋和它们与键盖薄壁的连接。
The button covers move into view and turn over, isolating the inner ribs and their connections to the thin cover walls.

title: ERSTE002
ERSTE002
body: 五组部件回到原装配位置。整机采用无底壳方案，约 33 g 为设计目标。
The five groups return to their assembled positions. The open-base design targets a weight of approximately 33 g.
